headline: IOI *behaviour* survives GPT-2 small→XL and reappears stronger in modern small models (Qwen2.5-0.5B logit-diff +5.06), but NOT in the Pythia generation (70M/410M/2.8B all prefer the wrong name); and the discovered fixed-size circuit's faithfulness collapses with GPT-2 scale — anchor 87.8% → medium 41.5% → large 11.5%.

figures.caption: Discovered-circuit faithfulness F(C)/F(M) (left, solid) collapses across GPT-2 scale (small 88.6% → large 11.5%) while baseline IOI logit-diff (right, dotted) stays high for GPT-2 and modern models but is negative for Pythia. Dashed line = paper 87% / anchor 87.8%. gpt2-xl open marker = 3-class partial.

figures.caption: Baseline IOI mean logit-diff (IO−S) vs params. GPT-2 family (3.5–4.5) and modern small models Qwen2.5-0.5B/SmolLM2-1.7B (4.2–5.1) all solve IOI; the entire Pythia family sits at or below zero (fails), except a weak pythia-1.4b.
figures.alt: Log-x scatter: GPT-2 and modern models well above zero, Pythia family near/below zero.

figures.caption: Count of discovered heads whose ablation moves logit-diff by ≥0.2, by class. GPT-2 small has strong heads in all six classes; by medium/large only name-mover + negative output heads remain strong (upstream chain becomes distributed); Pythia rungs have almost none.
figures.alt: Stacked bars: gpt2 tallest with all six colors; medium/large mostly name-mover+negative; Pythia bars tiny.

notes: Completeness/greedy search (C19/C21) dropped entirely per instruction (anchor-only); only faithfulness laddered.
gpt2-xl full 6-class circuit not finished (config b alone 38 min at N=30); its 28.4% is a 3-class output-side circuit, flagged partial. pythia-2.8b config-a only.
Tier-2 (Qwen2.5-0.5B, SmolLM2-1.7B) is behavioural-only via raw HF — shows behaviour survival, not circuit survival. OLMo-2-0425-1B skipped (arch unknown to transformers 4.46.3).
Pythia rungs with F(M)≤0 (70m/410m/2.8b fail the task) have mathematically-defined but meaningless faithfulness ratios — reported as n/a, not as numbers.

Per-model faithfulness is of a mechanically-DISCOVERED top-k circuit, not the paper's hand-curated 26-head set; the two coincide on GPT-2 small (88.6% vs 87.8%), which licenses the comparison. Path-patch N reduced to 50/30 for the largest models (48GB); baseline always N=2000. Weights downloaded fresh (only gpt2 was cached); no /home writes.
Pythia name filter keeps 88/99 single-token names; all models ≥15 so none was marked not-attempted.
